samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulate four input data and output.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">Input data.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Valid input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid output.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">Output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WAIT_CNT" value="2'd0">Wait state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ACCUMULATE_CNT" value="2'd1">Accumulate state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT_CNT" value="2'd2">Output state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[1:0]">Counter.</reg>
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">State.</reg>
        <reg id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">Output data.</reg>
        <reg id="valid_out">Valid output.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <case>
            <case_item condition="'state == WAIT_CNT'">
                <if condition="'valid_in == 1'">
                    <then>
                        <assign value="'cnt <= 0'"/>
                        <assign value="'state <= ACCUMULATE_CNT'"/>
                        <assign value="'data_out <= data_in'"/>
                        <assign value="'valid_out <= 0'"/>
                    </then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>
                        <assign value="'state <= WAIT_CNT'"/>
                        <assign value="'valid_out <= 0'"/>
                    </then>
                </else>
            </case_item>
            <case_item condition="'state == ACCUMULATE_CNT'">
                <if condition="'cnt == 3'">
                    <then>
                        <assign value="'state <= OUTPUT_CNT'"/>
                        <assign value="'valid_out <= 1'"/>
                    </then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>
                        <assign value="'cnt <= cnt + 1'"/>
                        <assign value="'data_out <= data_out + data_in'"/>
                        <assign value="'state <= ACCUMULATE_CNT'"/>
                        <assign value="'valid_out <= 0'"/>
                    </then>
                </else>
            </case_item>
            <case_item condition="'state == OUTPUT_CNT'">
                <if condition="'valid_in == 1'">
                    <then>
                        <assign value="'cnt <= 0'"/>
                        <assign value="'state <= ACCUMULATE_CNT'"/>
                        <assign value="'data_out <= data_in'"/>
                        <assign value="'valid_out <= 0'"/>
                    </then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>
                        <assign value="'state <= WAIT_CNT'"/>
                        <assign value="'valid_out <= 0'"/>
                    </then>
                </else>
            </case_item>
        </case>
    </implementation>
</module>
